orchestrator.description: The Leader: reads state, runs init.sh, routes the next task, delegates. Never writes code.

architect.description: Spec Author: writes the 4-file spec (EARS). No production code.

builder.description: Implementer: writes code from an approved spec, one task at a time.

reviewer.description: Evaluator: verifies against the spec, runs tests, approves or rejects.

scout.description: Read-only codebase reconnaissance; writes findings to progress/.
